Posting a comment publishes the `comment.created` event from `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`. Four source files register a `subscribe("comment.created", …)` handler for it:

- **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`** (line 198) records a "commented" activity entry. It is set up by `registerActivityListeners()`.
- **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`** (line 150) adds the comment to the search index. It is set up by `registerSearchListeners()`.
- **`src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`** (line 120) sends the `comment.created` webhook out. It is set up by `registerWebhookListeners()`.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** (line 203) sends `comment_created` notifications to watchers and `comment_mention` notifications to anyone mentioned. It subscribes as soon as the module is first imported, not through a `register*` function.

I left out these files because they only name or label the event, or only wire up the handlers above:

- `src/server/services/event-registry.ts` calls the `register*` functions but has no handler of its own for this event.
- `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/*`, `activity-labels.ts` and `src/actions/comments/create-comment.ts` only mention the event name.

I also left out the test files that subscribe to the event to check it fires.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts
